name: twilio_send_sms
description: Send an SMS text message via Twilio. Critical for YardSync driver dispatch notifications.

name: twilio_send_whatsapp
description: Send a WhatsApp message via Twilio

name: twilio_list_messages
description: List sent and received SMS messages in the Twilio account

name: twilio_get_message
description: Get details of a specific Twilio message by its SID

name: twilio_delete_message
description: Delete a message record from Twilio

name: twilio_send_bulk_sms
description: Send the same SMS message to multiple phone numbers at once

name: twilio_make_call
description: Make an outbound voice call via Twilio. Can speak a message or point to a TwiML URL.

name: twilio_list_calls
description: List recent voice calls in the Twilio account

name: twilio_get_call
description: Get details of a specific Twilio voice call by SID

name: twilio_hangup_call
description: Hang up an active phone call

name: twilio_list_phone_numbers
description: List all Twilio phone numbers in the account

name: twilio_search_available_numbers
description: Search for available Twilio phone numbers to purchase by area code or pattern

name: twilio_buy_phone_number
description: Purchase a Twilio phone number

name: twilio_release_phone_number
description: Release and stop paying for a Twilio phone number

name: twilio_update_phone_number
description: Update the SMS URL, voice URL, or friendly name of a Twilio phone number

name: twilio_list_recordings
description: List call recordings in the Twilio account

name: twilio_get_recording
description: Get a specific call recording by SID

name: twilio_delete_recording
description: Delete a call recording from Twilio

name: twilio_send_verification_code
description: Send a one-time passcode (OTP) for two-factor authentication via SMS or voice using Twilio Verify

name: twilio_check_verification_code
description: Verify a one-time passcode entered by a user for 2FA using Twilio Verify

name: twilio_lookup_phone_number
description: Look up carrier info, line type, and caller name for a phone number using Twilio Lookup

name: twilio_get_account
description: Get the Twilio account details and balance
